items.summary_html:
NVIDIA has expanded its robotics simulation and training ecosystem with dedicated "Robot Gym" reinforcement learning pipelines under Isaac Lab and Project GR00T, enabling physical AI models and humanoid robots to train across thousands of parallel virtual physics environments before real-world deployment. Globally, the UK pledged £600 million toward AI security threats, Bank of America projected global data center spending to hit $2.1 trillion by 2028, and Anthropic’s S-1 filing revealed $450 billion in non-cancellable cloud commitments alongside $80.7 billion in first-half net losses. Domestically, Swiggy plummeted 24.5% to trigger an $11 billion market rout across Indian new-age tech stocks following steep Instamart losses, IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw confirmed a consultation paper for a formal AI law is arriving within weeks, Madhya Pradesh secured ₹15,400 crore in semiconductor and data center commitments, and Adani University teamed up with BITS Pilani to revamp deep-tech engineering curricula.

This is your Front Page LIVE, bringing you sharp analysis of the biggest technology, business, policy and economic stories shaping India and the world.

Today on Front Page LIVE:
* NVIDIA advances its Robot Gym reinforcement learning framework to accelerate physical AI and humanoid training
* Swiggy shares crash 24.5% to ₹176.70 as Q2 Instamart losses spark an $11B sell-off across 63 new-age tech stocks
* Anthropic's S-1 filing exposes $450B in non-cancellable cloud commitments and $80.7B in H1 net losses
* Bank of America projects global data center infrastructure spending to reach $2.1 trillion by 2028
* UK government commits £600M to AI biosecurity and health defense, backed by OpenAI and Anthropic model credits
* Ashwini Vaishnaw announces an upcoming consultation paper for India’s first comprehensive AI legislation
* Wiz AI models identify critical PHP vulnerabilities rated 9.2 affecting 70% of web servers over the past decade
* Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3.1 Pro ranks 4th globally on Artificial Analysis Index amid Anthropic distillation claims
* Madhya Pradesh draws ₹15,400 crore at its Indore summit, including a ₹6,415 crore Gwalior data center
* Indian tech startups raise $184M across 17 deals as overall venture funding falls 22%
* BITS Pilani invests ₹50 crore in deep-tech labs while Adani University rolls out industry semiconductor programs
